messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/10542 is ready for review but we can't merge until we get a short design sign-off. I added a 2-paragraph summary in the PR description but cc'ing arch for a concise yes/no. RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/GC-8423

morgan: Thanks — can you paste the SLO/latency delta in-thread? small numbers help me validate risk quickly.

alex: Sure — quick summary: expected P50 unaffected, P95 +1.8ms, P99 +3.6ms on gen-heavy tails. Cost/unit ~ +0.6% due to an extra KV-prefetch step. Rollback is a single flip (route to model-v2) and KV prefetch removed.

sam: Sounds low but need confirmation that fallback path is exercised in canary. Is there a 1-hr canary window we can run on staging with real traffic replay? Also need owner for on-call notification during canary.

tara: I can own the canary tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PT. I'll run the replay and monitor P50/P95/P99, error rates, and memory. @morgan — can you add the canary acceptance criteria?

morgan: Acceptance: P99 <= baseline +5ms, errors unchanged, no OOMs. If P99 > baseline+5ms or errors spike >0.5% absolute, rollback immediately. :thumbsup:

alex: Added a minimal rollout snippet in the PR for the ops runbook:```yaml
canary:
  duration: 60m
  traffic_percent: 10
  metrics: [p50, p95, p99, error_rate]
rollback: route: model-v2
```

morgan: Need one more thing — can we get the RFC author to confirm this particular KV-prefetch change is covered by GC-8423? The RFC is broad and I want an explicit line.

alex: @sam @tara GC-8423, section "prefetch semantics" bullet 3 covers the behavior but I added a comment linking the exact paragraph.

sam: Cool. I'll do a quick code review pass after the design ack. If arch signs off we can queue the merge into tomorrow's release window.

tara: I'll run the canary and post metrics in this thread. assigning on-call to watch: @oncall-runtime.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary job created -> job/cron-canary-10542 at 2025-12-11T16:00:00Z (staging). logs: http://ci.internal/jobs/10542/logs

alex: Thanks all — pinging @morgan for the final design ack when you have a sec.
morgan: Ack from me — design summary lines match RFC and safety checklist looks fine. you have my sign-off, go ahead with canary. :white_check_mark:

alex: Great — PR is unblocked. I'll wait for canary metrics then request merge.

tara: Canaries running now — I'll drop a short results summary in ~45m.
